nuances.title: 二 vs 两 before measure words and amounts
nuances.ai_likely_does: Says 二个人, 二张票, 二点钟, 二百块 by mapping the digit 2 directly.
nuances.native_does: Uses 两 (liǎng) before measure words and most quantities: 两个人, 两张票, 两点 (2 o'clock), 两百块. 二 (èr) is only the bare digit/ordinal: 第二, 二楼.

nuances.title: Phone/code digit readout: 幺 for 1, 两 for 2
nuances.ai_likely_does: Reads phone numbers and codes digit-by-digit as 一 (yī) for every 1 and 二 (èr) for 2.
nuances.native_does: On the phone, 1 is read 幺 (yāo) to avoid confusion with 七: 13800138000 → 幺三八零零幺三八零零零. Zero is 零 (líng).

nuances.title: Domain-specific measure words, not default 个
nuances.ai_likely_does: Overuses 个 (gè) for everything: 一个票, 一个航班, 一个行李.
nuances.native_does: Selects the right classifier: 一张票/机票 (zhāng), 一个航班 or 一班飞机 (bān), 一件行李 (jiàn), 一位 (wèi, polite for people), 一笔退款/费用 (bǐ, for sums), 一份订单 (fèn).

nuances.title: Native airline/CS terms vs English-calqued ones
nuances.ai_likely_does: Code-switches or calques: says 'flight' / 'booking' / 'refund', or invents 飞行 for flight.
nuances.native_does: Uses established terms: 航班 (flight), 预订/订票 (booking), 退款 (refund), 改签 (rebook/change), 退票 (ticket refund), 值机 (check-in), 登机牌 (boarding pass), 订单号 (order number).

nuances.title: 买 mǎi vs 卖 mài (buy vs sell)
nuances.ai_likely_does: Produces the wrong tone, saying 卖 (mài, sell) when meaning 买 (mǎi, buy) — reversing who does what.
nuances.native_does: Keeps them distinct: 我想买一张票 (I want to buy a ticket) vs 卖 (sell). A tone flip here yields a real, wrong word.

nuances.title: 您 vs 你 in service register
nuances.ai_likely_does: Defaults to flat 你 (nǐ) throughout, sounding blunt to an agent.
nuances.native_does: Caller and agent both lean on 您 (nín) in service calls: 您好, 请问您…. Pure 你 reads as curt.

nuances.title: Verbalizing email @ and . natively
nuances.ai_likely_does: Says English 'at' and 'dot', or literal 在 / 点点 for @ and the dot.
nuances.native_does: @ spoken as '艾特' (àitè) or 'at'; dot is 点 (diǎn). e.g. abc@gmail.com → 'a-b-c 艾特 gmail 点 com'. Underscore _ is 下划线, hyphen - is 横杠/减号.

nuances.title: Dates with 号 and year read digit-by-digit
nuances.ai_likely_does: Reads 2025 as 两千零二十五, or uses 日 in speech.
nuances.native_does: Years read digit-by-digit: 2025年 → 二〇二五年. Spoken dates use 号 not 日: 6月23号. 日 (rì) is written/formal.

nuances.title: Money: 块/毛 in speech vs 元/角 in writing
nuances.ai_likely_does: Says 元 (yuán) and 角 (jiǎo) aloud, or appends a stray measure word.
nuances.native_does: Colloquial speech uses 块 (kuài) for yuan and 毛 (máo) for jiao: 三百二十块五, 两块五毛. 元/角 sound like reading a written receipt aloud.

nuances.title: Translationese connectors and pronoun overuse
nuances.ai_likely_does: Over-translates English structure: explicit subject pronouns every clause (我想要…我需要…我有…), 'because…so' as 因为…所以… in full each time.
nuances.native_does: Drops redundant pronouns (topic-prominent: 票订好了，想改一下), uses 请问/麻烦您 to open requests, and uses only 因为 OR 所以. Prefers 想 over 我想要 stacks.

nuances.title: Sentence-final particles 吧/呢/啊/嘛
nuances.ai_likely_does: Either omits all sentence-final particles (clipped, textbook) or sprinkles 吗 on sentences that already have a question word.
nuances.native_does: Uses 吧 for softened suggestions (那就改到周五吧), 呢 for follow-up questions (那退款呢？), 啊 to soften (好啊). Never 吗 with an existing interrogative; 嘛 marks 'obviously'.

nuances.title: Native hesitation fillers vs English-style ones
nuances.ai_likely_does: Inserts 'um/uh', or over-literal 好的好的好的, or written 那么 as a filler.
nuances.native_does: Uses 那个 (nèige) and 这个 as hesitation fillers, 就是 as a stall, 嗯 as a thinking sound, 然后 to chain. e.g. 那个…我想问一下.

nuances.title: Backchannels: 嗯/对/好的 while listening
nuances.ai_likely_does: Stays silent until its full turn, then replies, or backchannels with translated 'okay'/'I see'.
nuances.native_does: Drops short backchannels: 嗯, 对对对, 好的, 行, 明白了. Confirming agreement uses 对 not 是 for 'that's right'.

nuances.title: Request softeners 麻烦/帮我/可以…吗
nuances.ai_likely_does: Issues bare imperatives modeled on English ('Cancel my booking') → 取消我的订单, sounding demanding.
nuances.native_does: Frames requests with softeners: 麻烦您帮我…, 我想…不知道可以吗, 能不能…. Thanks with 谢谢/辛苦了.

nuances.title: Spelling/confirming Chinese names by character decomposition
nuances.ai_likely_does: Reads names letter-by-letter in pinyin or just states the syllables, unable to disambiguate homophones.
nuances.native_does: Disambiguates by decomposition: 弓长张 (the 张 made of 弓+长) vs 立早章; 木子李. Or '国家的国'. Surname first.

nuances.title: Alphanumeric PNR/code readout
nuances.ai_likely_does: Reads codes as run-together English letters, no segmentation.
nuances.native_does: Reads record locators letter-by-letter, clarifying with 大写 (uppercase); reads separators - as 杠/横杠, / as 斜杠; uses 幺 for 1 inside codes. e.g. 订单号是 A 幺 三 杠 七.

nuances.title: 了 for completed/changed state
nuances.ai_likely_does: Omits aspectual 了 (le) where a state change occurred (我收到邮件 instead of 我收到邮件了).
nuances.native_does: Marks completion with 了: 我已经付款了, 航班取消了, 好了. Missing 了 makes completed actions sound like generic statements.

nuances.title: 措辞 for cancel: 取消 vs 退订 vs 改签
nuances.ai_likely_does: Uses one blanket word (取消) for refunding, changing, and cancelling, calquing English 'cancel'.
nuances.native_does: Distinguishes: 取消 (void an order), 退订/退票 (cancel-and-refund), 改签 (change flight), 退款 (get money back). 取消航班 implies the airline cancelled the flight, not the customer.
